blocks.task_summary: Solve the homogeneous DE via substitution y = vx, separation of variables, integration, and initial condition y(1)=2 to obtain y^2 = 4x^2(1 - ln x).
method_path: Substitute y = vx, giving dy/dx = v + x dv/dx
Substitute into DE: (v^2 x^2 - 2x^2)/(v x^2) = v + x dv/dx simplifies to x dv/dx = -2/v
Integrate both sides: v^2/2 = -2 ln|x| + c
Back-substitute v = y/x: y^2/(2x^2) = -2 ln|x| + c
Apply initial condition y(1)=2: 2 = 0 + c so c = 2

evidence.basis: let y = vx implies dy/dx = v + x dv/dx (A1); substitution into DE (M1); simplification to x dv/dx = -2/v (A1); separation integral v dv = -2 integral dx/x (M1); integration v^2/2 = -2 ln x + c (A1); back-substitution y^2/(2x^2) = -2 ln x + c (A1); attempt to substitute x=1, y=2 to find c gives c=2 (M1); final answer y^2 = 4x^2(1 - ln x) (A1).

blocks.task_summary: Set dy/dx = 0 in the DE giving y^2 = 2x^2, hence y = +/- sqrt(2) x and m = +/- sqrt(2).
method_path: Set dy/dx = 0 in the differential equation: (y^2 - 2x^2)/(xy) = 0
Take square roots: y = +/- sqrt(2) x
accepted_alternatives: y = sqrt(2) x and y = -sqrt(2) x

evidence.basis: attempt to set dy/dx = 0 in the differential equation (M1); y = sqrt(2) x and y = -sqrt(2) x or m = +/- sqrt(2) (A1).
